bookImport.title: Import books from CSV
bookImport.description: One book per line. Required columns: title, author, category. Optional: age_range, isbn, publication_year, language, status, cover_url, image_urls, description, tags (names or slugs separated by |), series and series_position (a new series name creates the series). Nothing is imported while any line has an error.
